items.prompt: A site has an HTTPS padlock. What does that mean?
choices: The site definitely belongs to an official organization
The connection is encrypted, but the owner isn't necessarily honest
The site has been checked by the cyber police
items.explanation: HTTPS only encrypts the connection between the browser and the site. Scam sites can use HTTPS too.

items.prompt: Which address really belongs to Bank Nusantara (banknusantara.test)?
items.explanation: In login.banknusantara.test, the owner is banknusantara.test and login is just a subdomain. The other two belong to akun-aman.test and banknusantara-login.test.
